description: This file defines a repository class for managing seat change logs, including creating logs, retrieving monthly changes, unprocessed changes, marking logs as processed, and fetching team billing IDs. It interacts with a Prisma ORM client and references external Prisma models and enums.

classes.name: SeatChangeLogRepository
classes.description: Repository class for seat change logs, providing methods to create logs, retrieve monthly and unprocessed changes, mark logs as processed, and fetch billing IDs.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new seat change log entry, using upsert if operationId is provided to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: getMonthlyChanges
methods.description: Retrieves the total additions and removals of seats for a given team and month.

methods.name: getUnprocessedChanges
methods.description: Fetches unprocessed seat change logs for a specific team and month.

methods.name: markAsProcessed
methods.description: Marks seat change logs as processed by setting the proration ID.

methods.name: getTeamBillingIds
methods.description: Fetches billing IDs associated with a team, throwing an error if the team is not found.
